stories.brief: The Starmind constellation aims to be the most cost and energy-efficient way to meet the growing demand for AI computing power.

stories.title: Makkah pact nations to discuss Yemen in Islamabad meeting: Khawaja Asif
stories.brief: The Makkah pact nations will discuss the conflict between Saudi Arabia and Iran-backed Houthi fighters in Yemen when officials from the mutual defence agreement meet in Islamabad on Thursday, Defence Minister Khawaja Asif has told AFP.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz reaffirms commitment to stronger Pakistan-Bangladesh ties
stories.brief: Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif on Thursday reaffirmed Pakistan’s commitment to strengthening its fraternal relations with Bangladesh, emphasising the importance of shared history, cultural affinity, parliamentary cooperation and stronger people-to-people connections.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz announces committee to review, implement Jamaat-e-Islami’s economic proposals
stories.brief: Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif on Thursday announced the formation of a committee to further review and implement proposals presented by Jamaat-e-Islami (JI) aimed at improving the economy and providing relief to the people. The prime minister said several rounds of talks had been held between the government’s team and JI on the Ameer’s proposals.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz launches ‘Mehfooz Dawa’ app to combat counterfeit and substandard medicines
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Thursday launched the “Mehfooz Dawa” app to prevent the circulation of counterfeit and substandard medicines, calling it “a major milestone” and saying the initiative would help restore public confidence in the healthcare system.

stories.title: Sindh orders SBCA to halt illegal construction, demolish unoccupied structures
stories.brief: The Sindh government on Thursday directed the Sindh Building Control Authority (SBCA) to immediately stop construction of all illegal and unauthorised buildings and initiate demolition proceedings against gross violations, particularly structures that remain unoccupied. A day earlier, a six-storey under-construction building collapsed, killing four people and injuring 14 others.

stories.title: 'Unbelievable catch': Swat's motorbike passenger becomes cricket sensation
stories.brief: Returning home from work on the back of a friend's motorbike, Mehran Khan acted on pure instinct when a cricket ball sailed towards him, and he nonchalantly took a one-handed catch that won him instant global fame.

stories.title: NCCIA proposes three zones, 31 police stations across Sindh in major overhaul
stories.brief: The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) is considering a major organisational restructuring to improve its response to the growing number of complaints involving online harassment, financial fraud and other cybercrimes. A proposed framework for establishing NCCIA police stations in all 31 districts of Sindh, including Karachi, had also been prepared.

stories.title: Fazl warns of nationwide shutdown if convoy impeded as JUI takes out protests in multiple cities, blocks roads
stories.brief: Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam-Fazl (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman on Thursday warned of a "nationwide shutdown" if the party's convoy was impeded en route to Sargodha, as news emerged of the party blocking roads and highways across the country in a protest call.

stories.title: PM inaugurates 'Mehfooz Dawa' app to help public identify substandard medicines
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Thursday inaugurated the ‘Mehfooz Dawa’ mobile application, a digital initiative aimed at enabling citizens to verify the authenticity of medicines and protect against counterfeit and substandard drugs.
